articles.title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
articles.snippet: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest pulls the plug on two planned crypto ETFs
articles.snippet: ProShares' rival CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF (KRYP) holds $1.81 million in assets nearly 10 months post-launch.

articles.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
articles.snippet: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds from 2-year low as Wall Street futures recover
articles.snippet: Monday's market activity will show whether the weekend decline was seen as a dip and traders add to their holdings, or whether they abstain and the bounce fades.

articles.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
articles.snippet: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.
